description.zh:
交换机的网段。交换机网段要求如下：
- 交换机的网段的掩码长度范围为16~29位。
- 交换机的网段必须从属于所在VPC的网段。
- 交换机的网段不能与所在VPC中路由条目的目标网段相同，但可以是目标网段的子集。
description.en:
The CIDR block of the VSwitch. The following requirements apply:

- The prefix length must be an integer from 16 to 29.

- The CIDR block of the VSwitch must be a subset of the CIDR block of the VPC to which the VSwitch belongs.

- The CIDR block of the VSwitch cannot be the same as the destination CIDR block of an existing route in the VPC, but it can be a subset of the destination CIDR block.

description.zh:
交换机的描述信息。

描述长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The description of the VSwitch.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The ID of the ENS node.

description.zh: 要创建的交换机所属的网络ID。
description.en: The ID of the network to which the VSwitch belongs.
The tags of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tags.

description.zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围为**1**~**20**。

- 不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或`https://`开头。
- 最多支持64个字符。
- 不允许传入空字符串。
description.en:
The key of the tag.

- The tag key cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`.

- The tag key can be up to 64 characters long.

- The tag key cannot be an empty string.

description.zh: 资源的标签值。N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The value of the tag. It can be up to 128 characters long, can be an empty string, and cannot start with `acs:` or contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
交换机名称。命名规则如下：

- 长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。
- 必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以 http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。

默认值：空。
description.en:
The name of the VSwitch. The following requirements apply:

- The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.

- The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

Default value: an empty string.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens create-vswitch --ens-region-id cn-xian-unicom --cidr-block 172.16.0.0/24 --vswitch-name Test_vSwitch --description This_is_my_vswitch. --network-id n-257gqcdfvx6n0000 --tag Value=Deep Key=team --ipv6-cidr-block 2408:XXXX:0:a600::/110 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens CreateVSwitch --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key team --Description 'This_is_my_vswitch.' --Tag.1.Value Deep --CidrBlock '172.16.0.0/24' --VSwitchName Test_vSwitch --EnsRegionId 'cn-xian-unicom' --NetworkId 'n-257gqcdfvx6n0000' --Ipv6CidrBlock '2408:XXXX:0:a600::/110'
